bash_commands: git status --short && ls && cat pixforge/features/generate.py && ls tests 2>/dev/null; find . -name "*.py" -not -path "./.git/*" | head -50

cat pixforge/quota.py pixforge/i18n.py pixforge/features/common.py pixforge/clock.py pixforge/users.py && echo ---- && cat tests/test_generate.py tests/conftest.py && echo ---- && grep -n "def \|^class" pixforge/jobs.py pixforge/db.py pixforge/pricing.py && grep -rn "quota" --include=*.py . | grep -v "^./pixforge/quota.py"

cat pixforge/features/video.py && echo ---- && cat tests/test_video.py && echo ---- && ls pixforge/locales && cat pixforge/locales/en.json pixforge/locales/ru.json && echo ---- && grep -rn "quota_usage" -A8 pixforge/*.py pixforge/migrations 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls pixforge; grep -n "quota\|video\|image" -i README.md docs/* 2>/dev/null | head -30; cat pixforge/pricing.py | head -30; cd tests && cat test_i18n.py | head -30

cat >> tests/test_generate.py <<'EOF'


def test_free_daily_image_limit(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(5):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")["ok"]
    response = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-5")
    assert not response["ok"]
    assert response["error_code"] == "daily_image_limit"
    assert response["job_id"] is None
    assert "5" in response["message"]
    assert len(lumen.calls) == 5
    assert get_balance(conn, user_id) == 90


def test_daily_image_limit_message_is_localized(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(5):
        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")
    response = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-5", locale="ru")
    assert response["message"] == (
        "Вы исчерпали дневной лимит бесплатного тарифа: 5 изображений."
    )


def test_daily_image_limit_resets_on_next_utc_day(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(5):
        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")
    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 2, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-5")["ok"]


def test_pro_images_are_unlimited(conn, lumen, pro_user_id):
    for i in range(quota.FREE_DAILY_LIMITS["image"] + 2):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, pro_user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")["ok"]
    assert quota.used(conn, pro_user_id, "image") == 0


def test_retry_at_limit_returns_original_result_without_using_quota(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(5):
        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")
    retry = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-4")
    assert retry["ok"]
    assert len(lumen.calls) == 5


def test_failed_generation_releases_its_quota_slot(conn, lumen, user_id):
    lumen.fail_with = LumenAPIError(500, "internal", "boom")
    generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-1")
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 0


def test_filtered_generation_releases_its_quota_slot(conn, lumen, user_id):
    lumen.filter_next = True
    generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-1")
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 0


def test_insufficient_credits_releases_its_quota_slot(conn, lumen):
    from pixforge.users import create_user

    poor = create_user(conn, "poor@example.com", balance=1)
    generate_image(conn, lumen, poor, "a cat", "req-1")
    assert quota.used(conn, poor, "image") == 0
EOF
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -30
